notes.title: Update v0.1.1
notes.content:
With our demo being live for the past couple of weeks we've been super excited to have Monster Mash in front of people finally! We've gotten some feedback on things and have also been busy playtesting internally. With this latest patch, we've squashed a few bugs, made a few changes to code, and even added in some new content!

· New musical track for Metroville.
· Updated model of Boxing Glove Gun.
· Updated model of Laser Guided Mallet.
· New Formula Z drink drops in Metroville.
· New Hot Sauce drops in Metroville.
· Decreased maximum amount of time between enemy spawns.
· Decreased maximum wait time between UFO spawns.
· Fixed remnants of food items not colliding with buildings properly.
· Adjusted minimum and maximum spawn times for UFO's.
· Items now play a sound when dropped on the ground.

Bug Fixes:
· Fixed medal graphics in round end menu not appearing correctly.
· Fixed player being able to move after the round was over or they had died.
· Fixed audio cues not triggering properly when firearms were out of ammo.
· Fixed some objects not awarding points properly.

I plan on updating the demo continuously until the actual release of the game. This may or may not include certain additions like new weapons, snacks, and enemies to essentially test the waters and players' feedback will be crucial throughout the lifetime of the demo.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: DevLog #1: Free Demo
notes.content:
[b]It’s here![/b] You can play a free demo of Monster Mash while we’re in Early Access! This demo showcases a beginning level, Metroville, USA, as well as some basic weapons and snacks. There is more content that exists already and even more planned beyond that. I’m super excited to share more and more as it becomes ready.

Nothing is more critical right now than getting this feeling right. Monster Mash is still in a very early state, so all the feedback possible is crucial and absolutely appreciated.

[i]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/7TASntvFvQ]Discord[/url] server which is also pretty new. Players can report bugs and problems in the #bugs channel.[/i]

[u]Known Bugs:[/u]
[list]
[*]No music! The game is very quiet right now but there’s custom music being made right now!
[*]Sometimes a weapon can attach to the player’s hand at an incorrect orientation or at a small distance away.
[*]Sometimes a weapon won’t destroy a building right away if the collider is moving very fast, or very slowly.
[*]Static objects can get stuck to the player’s hand after releasing the object, but can still be destroyed by smashing it on something else.
[*]Hands are frozen in position while the tutorial prompt is active. The laser pointer line will bend, allowing you to still select buttons.
[*]Some weapons or snacks might not have icons associated yet and will appear as the monster’s head in the Logbook once acquired.
[*]The Logbook still has placeholder text in some places.
[/list]

[i]Happy smashing![/i]
